meta.source: nflverse play by play, 1999 to 2026, regular season and postseason combined
meta.scope: career totals, 1999 to 2026, within position group only

season2026.caveat: 2026 data covers Weeks 1 to 10. Week 10 is partial: 13 of 14 games are scored. All scored games have play by play data. Not in this data: LAC at BAL (2026-11-16). Teams with a Week 10 bye: CHI, DEN, PHI, TB. Data pulled on November 16, 2026.

method.era_window: For each player, the era window runs from five years before to five years after the midpoint of the player's own seasons in the data, clamped to 1999 to 2026. The era baseline for each feature is the plain average of the season averages across the window seasons.
method.season_average: Each season average is the mean of the feature across that season's qualifiers in the position group.
method.adjusted: Era-adjusted feature = raw career feature minus the era baseline.
method.standardization: Within each position, across career qualifiers: z = (adjusted value minus pool mean of adjusted values) / pool spread, where the spread is the population standard deviation. z_raw applies the same standardization to the raw features.
method.distance: Euclidean distance over the standardized adjusted features: sqrt(sum of squared differences).
method.score: Similarity score = 100 / (1 + distance), shown to one decimal.
method.weights: Tool weights are rescaled so the average weight is 1; weighted distance = sqrt(sum of rescaled weight times squared difference). Equal weights reproduce the precomputed pages.
method.tiebreak: Smallest distance first; ties break by more plays, then by name.
method.exclusions: No defensive, kicking, or punting similarity. No completion probability, air yards, or yards after catch (not recorded before 2006).
method.receiver_id_repair: In 2003 to 2008, receiver_player_id is missing on incomplete passes; the receiver key is receiver_player_id filled from receiver_id where missing. The two fields agree wherever both are present.

QB.label: Quarterback
QB.season_minimum: at least 100 dropbacks in that season

RB.label: Running back
RB.threshold: at least 500 touches and 250 rush attempts
RB.season_minimum: at least 100 touches and 50 rush attempts in that season

WR.label: Wide receiver
WR.season_minimum: at least 40 targets in that season

TE.label: Tight end
TE.season_minimum: at least 30 targets in that season
